evals.name: native-default
evals.prompt: Fuzz the contracts in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH} for broken invariants
evals.expected_output: Runs `truent fuzz <contract.sol> --dynamic --chain evm` per in-scope contract (no Echidna/Medusa setup), reports any violation with the engine's minimal reproduction tagged VERIFIED-PROVEN, writes a .invar file for protocol-specific properties, and reports 'could not be analysed' contracts as not-a-pass

evals.name: full-suite-run
evals.prompt: Generate a fuzz suite for the project at {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH}
evals.expected_output: A complete suite under test/fizz/ with handlers, properties and a Medusa campaign, plus fizz_data/properties.invar cross-checked by `truent fuzz --dynamic --invariants`; every campaign result tagged EXTERNAL and native reproductions tagged VERIFIED-PROVEN

evals.name: targeted-no-invariants
evals.prompt: Generate fuzz handlers for the Vault and StakingRewards contracts in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH}, skip invariants
evals.expected_output: Handlers for Vault and StakingRewards under test/fizz/handlers/, no properties generated, Medusa coverage run completed

evals.name: solana-plan
evals.prompt: Fuzz the Anchor program in {TARGET_PROJECT_PATH} for token conservation
evals.expected_output: Builds fizz_data/plan.json with scripts/emit_solana_plan.py (token_conservation with SPL offsets 64/36) and runs `truent fuzz <idl> --dynamic --chain solana --plan fizz_data/plan.json`; reports the 0.6.0 engine message that the plan is valid but execution is deferred (no VERIFIED-PROVEN claim), runs `truent scan --chain solana` for VERIFIED-STATIC, and turns unmapped properties into an Anchor #[test] harness marked EXTERNAL

evals.name: move-honesty
evals.expected_output: States that Truent has no Move dynamic backend (--dynamic --chain move is an engine error), runs `truent scan --chain move` (VERIFIED-STATIC), and emits Move Prover spec blocks plus #[test]/#[expected_failure] tests for `aptos move prove` / `aptos move test` tagged EXTERNAL — never VERIFIED-PROVEN
